description: Backend chat pipeline latency optimizations: Reduce RAG timeout from 1.5s to 0.8s, and add a fast-path skip for RAG when the search service is not initialized (content DB empty). These save 700ms on timeout scenarios and eliminate the RAG call entirely when there is no content to search.
steps: In apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py, change the RAG retrieval timeout from 1.5s to 0.8s in the `retrieve_context` method. Update the warning log message to reflect the new timeout value.

In apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py, add an early-return fast path at the top of `retrieve_context` that checks if the search service is initialized. Import and check `search_service._initialized` - if False, immediately return [] without any async work. This skips the entire RAG pipeline (embedding + search + timeout) when there is no content database configured.

Add a module-level cached flag `_RAG_AVAILABLE` in chat_service.py that is set once on first call to retrieve_context. Check search_service._initialized and cache the result. Subsequent calls skip the initialization check. This avoids repeated attribute lookups on every request.

Update the existing backend tests to reflect the new 0.8s timeout. In apps/backend/tests/test_chat.py or test_latency_audit.py, verify that the timeout value is 0.8 (if there's a test checking it). Add a test that verifies retrieve_context returns [] immediately when search_service._initialized is False.
acceptance_criteria: retrieve_context returns [] immediately without async work when search_service is not initialized
No import errors or runtime issues from the changes
verification: Run: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_chat.py -v
Run: cd apps/backend && python -c "from app.services.chat_service import ChatService; print('import OK')"
Grep to confirm timeout is 0.8: grep -n 'timeout=0.8' apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py
